verbs.name: autopilot.run
verbs.description: Receipted Autopilot : render → verify → MECHANICALLY self-fix from the receipt's fix_actions → re-verify, capped, all under ONE auto-checkpoint so the whole run reverts in one step. The self-fix loop is deterministic (no model): a render-param fix (lufs→normalize_loudness, uniform_border→fit:cover) merges into the next render; a timeline-edit fix (cut_on_word→edit.trim snap-to-word-edge, silence_at_edges→edit.trim_edges, caption overlap→captions.reflow) is applied as its verb. policy:"preview" (DEFAULT) renders+verifies once and returns the PLAN (what it WOULD fix) WITHOUT applying — approve first; "auto_low_risk" applies the mechanical fixes. comment_id pre-applies that review note's drafted changes (comment.apply). returns {job_id, checkpoint}; the clean report lands in the job result.

goal.description: Free-text label/intent for the run (recorded in the report; v1 does not LLM-plan arbitrary verbs from it — use comment_id for planned changes).

comment_id.description: Pre-apply this review note's drafted verb changes (comment.apply) before the verify/self-fix loop.

policy.description: preview (default) = stop at the plan/diff for approval; auto_low_risk = apply the mechanical fixes.

verbs.result: {job_id, checkpoint} — clean report in the job result: {summary_line, policy, goal, checks_pass, stalled, iterations, fixes_applied:[{check,via}], plan:[{check,fix_verb,auto_fixable,rationale}], changed:DiffSummary, checkpoint, receipt_ids, restore_hint}

x-async-result.const: {summary_line, policy, checks_pass, iterations, fixes_applied, plan, changed, checkpoint, receipt_ids, restore_hint} via jobs.status
